note: Hand marks, keyed by the clip's sha256. Floor points: four image points (1280x720) with floor metres, from smoke I's fresh-context markers; round-2 clips reuse their camera's points. Structures: base segments in image pixels (smoke I where drawn, hand marks otherwise). Trucks: fork and rear floor points per second, by hand. Never read by the model. Zones: smoke G's hand-drawn structure polygons (image px) where drawn; elsewhere a strip around each base segment stands in.
